_schema.label: LaTeX \label of the paper result (prop:…, lem:…, thm:…, cor:…)
_schema.statement: the paper's statement, one line, in words or LaTeX
_schema.decls: fully qualified Lean declarations that together prove it ([] if not formalised)
_schema.fidelity: exact | special-case | stronger-hypotheses | weaker-conclusion — how the Lean statement relates to the paper's
_schema.reason: required when decls is []: why it is not formalised (e.g. needs measure-theoretic SDE results absent from Mathlib)
_schema.status: written by lean_tools.py verify: verified | partial | failed | missing | unsound | stated | not_formalized

results.label: example:mv-optimum
results.statement: x* = mu/(gamma sigma^2) uniquely maximises mu x - (gamma sigma^2/2) x^2; x* rises in mu and (mu>0) falls in gamma
